panels.description: Driver version and GPU model per device.
panels.title: GPU Information

panels.description: Primary productivity signal: ratio of cycles an SM has at least one warp assigned. > 70% - compute units busy; < 30% - GPU is waiting or stalled.
panels.title: SM Active

panels.description:
GPU-Util only means at least one kernel ran in the sampling window.
Compare with SM Active: high Util + low SM Active = fake-busy.
panels.title: GPU Utilization

panels.description: Primary productivity signal: ratio of cycles an SM has at least one warp assigned. > 70% - compute units busy; < 30% - GPU is waiting or stalled.
panels.title: SM Active

panels.description: GPU Utilization only means at least one kernel ran in the sampling window - activity, not productivity. Compare with SM Active: high GPU Util + low SM Active = non-optimal or fake-busy activity
panels.title: GPU Utilization

panels.description: Tensor (HMMA) pipe activity. For FP16/BF16/INT8 workloads: > 70% (dashed line) = Tensor Core fast path in use; low while mixed precision is expected = missed fast path
panels.title: Tensor Core Utilisation

panels.description: How full the SMs are relative to maximum resident warps. Low occupancy with high SM Active can mean too little parallel work per kernel.
panels.title: SM Occupancy

panels.description: On-GPU memory-system activity. > 70% (dashed line) = memory-system pressure; high DRAM Active with low/medium SM Active = memory-bound - check access patterns, batch size, tensor layout.
panels.title: DRAM Active (memory-system pressure)

panels.description: FB_USED is NOT live tensor memory: it includes CUDA context, driver, runtime and caching-allocator pools.
panels.title: GPU Memory Usage

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu"} / DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_TOTAL{Hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.description:
Host <-> GPU traffic. 
High PCIe rates with low SM Active is transfer bottleneck
panels.title: PCIe Throughput

panels.description:
GPU <-> GPU peer traffic.
High NVLink rates with low SM Active is communication/sync bottleneck. No data on a multi-GPU node - traffic may be falling back to PCIe.
panels.title: NVLink Throughput

panels.description: Clocks dropping while SM Active / load stays high = thermal or power throttling.
panels.title: SM / Memory Clocks

panels.description: Why clocks are capped (NVML bitmask). Combined reasons show as bit sums. GPU Idle (1) during load gaps is normal; SW/HW Thermal, SW Power Cap and HW Power Brake under load explain throughput drops despite high utilization.
panels.title: Throttle Reasons (clocks event bitmask)

panels.description:
Fraction of time spent throttled. DCGM violation counters are cumulative nanoseconds.
Any sustained non-zero value under load = power cap or cooling problem.
panels.title: Throttle Time Ratio (power / thermal violations)

panels.description: Power draw per GPU. Draw pinned at the limit under load = power-cap throttling; correlate with Throttle Reasons.
panels.title: GPU Power Usage vs Limit

panels.description: GPU core and memory temperature. Rising temperature with falling clocks is a thermal throttling.
panels.title: GPU / Memory Temperature

panels.description: Hardware health over the selected window: ECC row remaps (uncorrectable growth = RMA candidate; row remap failure = degraded GPU) and PCIe replay retries (link quality).
panels.title: ECC & PCIe Link Health

panels.description: Empty owner columns = GPU not allocated to any pod. GPU allocated + SM Active near zero = idle_allocation: pod holds the GPU but does no work.

targets.expr: max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod, exported_container) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod, exported_container) (DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE{Hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: Current GPU Owners (namespace / pod / container)

panels.description: Productivity per owner. Series appear/disappear as GPU ownership changes.

targets.expr: max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod) (DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE{Hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu", exported_pod!=""})

panels.title: SM Active by Pod

panels.description: Memory attribution per owner.

targets.expr: max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu", exported_pod!=""})

panels.title: FB Used by Pod
